synopsis: Scenario generation tools describe and vary test situations, while test management tools select, execute and record runs and report coverage; scenario count alone is not coverage [f16014, f16015, f16016, f16030]. The market is modular: road-vehicle chains offer strong sensor and scenario tooling but weak soil physics, while heavy-machine tools offer strong terrain and hydraulics but thin sensor and scenario tooling, so a specialist physics engine is not a substitute for validation management [f15860, f8345]. Foretellix Foretify combines constrained-random, coverage-driven generation with large-scale validation management and external-simulator integration; its off-road relevance is documented by a March 2021 Volvo Autonomous Solutions partnership targeting mines and quarries, but it is not a machine or soil physics engine [f8621, f8622, f8625, f8627]. Evidence listed for VTD ScenarioEngine and dSPACE SIMPHERA is on-road only, off-road deployments of AVL SCENIUS and Scenic were not found, and esmini was not assessed—these are evidence gaps rather than proof that tools lack capabilities [f9199, f9204, f9189, f9209, f8836]. Before prototype arrival, the program should build a simulator-independent scenario library, campaign generator and automated verdict functions, backed by traceability, version control, continuous integration and result storage; the middle-cost stack does not supply large-scale coverage-driven scenario management [f7372, f16028, f9300].
